question: Should OpenClaw keep HEARTBEAT.md as the canonical proactive workspace file, or approve a compatibility-aware transition to a proactive filename?
rationale: The current name is a shipped public workspace/runtime and Gateway file contract, so automation cannot safely choose a new canonical filename, casing, alias policy, or migration behavior without maintainer product intent.

options.title: Keep HEARTBEAT.md Canonical
options.body: Preserve the current shipped contract and close or defer the rename unless stronger maintainer-backed UX evidence appears.

options.title: Approve Compatibility-Aware Rename
options.body: Choose the exact new filename and require an upgrade-safe transition that keeps existing HEARTBEAT.md workspaces and Gateway file consumers working.

options.title: Narrow To Docs Wording
options.body: Improve newcomer docs around proactive heartbeat behavior without changing the runtime filename contract.

recommendation.title: Keep HEARTBEAT.md Canonical
recommendation.body: Preserve the current shipped contract and close or defer the rename unless stronger maintainer-backed UX evidence appears.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already left the product/compatibility routing comment on this issue and is tied to recent source-grounded heartbeat documentation work.
